privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This policy explains what information Rumuze collects through this website, why, and the choices you have. It covers rumuze.com and its Arabic version.

sections.title: 1. Who we are
sections.content: Rumuze is a software and digital marketing company based in Obour City, Cairo, Egypt. You can reach us at connect@rumuze.com.

sections.title: 2. Information we collect
sections.content:
• **What you send us:** your name, email, company, role, website, and the message or project details you submit through the contact form or chat.
• **Account details:** if you sign in with Google, your name, email address, profile photo, and Google account identifier.
• **Usage data, only if you accept:** the pages you view, referrer and campaign parameters (such as UTM tags), language, time zone, screen size, browser user agent, IP address, and random visitor and session identifiers.
• **Browser storage:** your theme and language preferences, your sign-in session, and the visitor and session identifiers above. Usage data is recorded only after you accept in the banner, and you can withdraw at any time from "Analytics preferences" in the footer.

sections.title: 3. How we use information
sections.content:
• To reply to your requests and run any engagement that follows.
• To provide, secure, and troubleshoot the website and your account.
• To understand how the site is used and improve it.

We do not sell your personal information.

sections.title: 4. Who we share it with
sections.content: We use service providers to run the site, such as Google (Firebase authentication, database, and functions) and hosting and network providers such as Cloudflare and Vercel. They process information on our behalf. To keep bots away from our database we use Firebase App Check with Google reCAPTCHA, which loads a script from Google and sends it browser and device signals. If you choose to message us on WhatsApp, WhatsApp handles that conversation under its own terms. Links to our social profiles open third-party sites with their own policies. We may also disclose information when the law requires it.

sections.title: 5. International processing
sections.content: Our providers may process information in countries other than yours. By using the site you understand that your information may be processed outside your country of residence.

sections.title: 6. How long we keep it
sections.content: We keep messages for as long as needed to handle your request and any resulting engagement. Usage data is kept for as long as it is useful for understanding site traffic. You can ask us to delete your information at any time.

sections.title: 7. Security
sections.content: The site is served over HTTPS and access to stored information is restricted. No online service is completely secure, so we cannot guarantee absolute security.

sections.title: 8. Your choices
sections.content: You can ask to access, correct, or delete the personal information we hold about you by emailing connect@rumuze.com. You can clear browser storage at any time, and sign out to end your session. Depending on where you live, the law may give you additional rights.

sections.title: 9. Changes and contact
sections.content: We may update this policy and will change the date above when we do. Questions about privacy can be sent to connect@rumuze.com.

terms.title: Terms of Use
terms.intro: These terms apply to your use of the Rumuze website. Work we do for clients is governed by a separate written agreement.

sections.title: 1. Using the website
sections.content: By using this website you agree to these terms. If you do not agree, please do not use it.

sections.title: 2. Our services
sections.content: Information on this website describes what Rumuze offers and is not a binding offer, quote, or guarantee. Engagements are defined in a written proposal or agreement agreed by both parties.

sections.title: 3. Intellectual property
sections.content: The content and design of this website belong to Rumuze unless stated otherwise. Open-source components remain under their own licences. You may not copy or reuse our content in a way that suggests it is yours.

sections.title: 4. Acceptable use
sections.content: Do not misuse the website: no attempts to disrupt it, gain unauthorised access, scrape it in a way that harms its operation, or submit unlawful or harmful content.

sections.title: 5. Accounts
sections.content: If you sign in, you are responsible for activity under your account. Tell us at connect@rumuze.com if you believe it has been compromised.

sections.title: 6. No warranty
sections.content: The website and its content are provided as they are, without warranties of any kind, to the extent permitted by law.

sections.title: 7. Limitation of liability
sections.content: To the extent permitted by law, Rumuze is not liable for indirect or consequential loss arising from your use of the website.

sections.title: 8. Third-party links
sections.content: The website may link to other sites. We are not responsible for their content or practices.

sections.title: 9. Changes and contact
sections.content: We may update these terms and will change the date above when we do. Questions can be sent to connect@rumuze.com.
